title: Riverbend Self-Pay Package Prices — Rendered Packages in Medical Hardship Documentation
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a rendered package is added to the qualifying medical debt Riverbend documents for its own charges.

**Rendered package.** The patient's Good Faith & Price Estimates package estimate whose service has been completed (Imaging & Diagnostics before Outpatient Surgery before Maternity & Delivery, and within one package variant the estimate listed first), while its linked Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account carries no package price adjustment yet; its package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line that carry the principal service code on its current version, co-provider lines not being part of it.

**Addition.**
- When a cesarean delivery charge (CPT 59510, 59514 or 59515) is posted on its linked account, the package price plus the package upgrade differential of its package tier is added.
- When no such charge is posted, the package price is added.
- Otherwise, when there is no rendered package, nothing is added.

| Package estimate | Package price adjustment on the linked account | Cesarean charge | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| service completed | none yet | posted | package price plus the tier's upgrade differential |
| service completed | none yet | not posted | package price |
| service completed | already posted | — | nothing (no rendered package) |
| none with service completed | — | — | nothing |

Hypothetical: a completed package whose current version carries a Riverbend facility line of 2,000.00 and a Riverbend professional line of 1,000.00 with the principal service code, plus a co-provider line of 500.00, has a package price of 3,000.00; with no package price adjustment yet and no cesarean charge, 3,000.00 is added.
